title: Crabface completes the expedition

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: You got a look in your eye, landlubber. A look I don't like.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got a look in your eye, landlubber. A look I don't like.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Captain Andalucia Ophelia Marquez the Fourth...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Captain Andalucia Ophelia Marquez the Fourth...

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: I can't believe you listened to those two old rust buckets.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't believe you listened to those two old rust buckets.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Where are the pieces?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where are the pieces?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: THAT ain't the Captain. That's trash.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: THAT ain't the Captain. That's trash.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Because I did it. I told Caleb and Salt Pete that I would put the Captain to rest. Scatter her remains to the four corners of the Gridless sea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because I did it. I told Caleb and Salt Pete that I would put the Captain to rest. Scatter her remains to the four corners of the Gridless sea.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Yeah. I guess I got a lot of explainin' to do. I always knew this day would come...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. I guess I got a lot of explainin' to do. I always knew this day would come...

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Well I ain't giving you the full story - it's too depressin'. You should tell Salt Pete to tell you why we was all fighin' and why we were out on the seas in the first place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I ain't giving you the full story - it's too depressin'. You should tell Salt Pete to tell you why we was all fighin' and why we were out on the seas in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: The three of us mutinied. I ain't proud to admit it. In the middle of a storm, the Captain went overboard. We were sailing North. Far North. Looking for The Gridless Sea. She fell, but we were squabbling when she needed us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The three of us mutinied. I ain't proud to admit it. In the middle of a storm, the Captain went overboard. We were sailing North. Far North. Looking for The Gridless Sea. She fell, but we were squabbling when she needed us.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: I... felt guilty I guess. It was me that started the argument. It was me that should have been looking out for the Captain when the mast hit her. I wanted to give them some peace. Even told them she could be repaired one day...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... felt guilty I guess. It was me that started the argument. It was me that should have been looking out for the Captain when the mast hit her. I wanted to give them some peace. Even told them she could be repaired one day...

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: He'll know what it means.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He'll know what it means.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm putting your Captain back together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm putting your Captain back together.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm putting your Captain back together.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm putting your Captain back together.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need help repairing something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need help repairing something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Wasn't she the third?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Wasn't she the third?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: No. Salt Pete and Caleb can't count. I can't believe you listened to those two old rust buckets.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Salt Pete and Caleb can't count. I can't believe you listened to those two old rust buckets.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can you fix her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you fix her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: On the boat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: On the boat.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Well, I got bad news for ya. For all of ya.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I got bad news for ya. For all of ya.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: It's trash. These are pieces of scrap metal. Shaped like the Captain, sure enough. But they are NOT the Captain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's trash. These are pieces of scrap metal. Shaped like the Captain, sure enough. But they are NOT the Captain.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How can that be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How can that be?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Four corners?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Four corners?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Go on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go on.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to the Captain?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to the Captain?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you find her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you find her?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: No... But a hundred years later, on the anniversary of the accident, I told the others I did find her body. I told them I found her, and I had already scattered her remains in the ocean. They asked where, and I told them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No... But a hundred years later, on the anniversary of the accident, I told the others I did find her body. I told them I found her, and I had already scattered her remains in the ocean. They asked where, and I told them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't get it.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: I threw some old debris in the sea in case anyone - like you - ever try to dredge her up again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I threw some old debris in the sea in case anyone - like you - ever try to dredge her up again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why did you lie to them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why did you lie to them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why did you lie to them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why did you lie to them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why DIDN'T they repair her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why DIDN'T they repair her?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Cos I told them it was against the Captain's wishes, which is true. The Captain always said "If the seas take me, don't try to take me back."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cos I told them it was against the Captain's wishes, which is true. The Captain always said "If the seas take me, don't try to take me back."

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And after all these years you still don't talk to one another?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And after all these years you still don't talk to one another?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And after all these years you still don't talk to one another?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And after all these years you still don't talk to one another?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Aye. To my shame... Aye. But you can tell them now. I tried to keep the secrets. Bury the truth below the waves, but the truth always gets washed up on shore eventually.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aye. To my shame... Aye. But you can tell them now. I tried to keep the secrets. Bury the truth below the waves, but the truth always gets washed up on shore eventually.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You shouldn't have lied to them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You shouldn't have lied to them.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You shouldn't have lied to them.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You shouldn't have lied to them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You were just trying to protect them I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You were just trying to protect them I guess.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You were just trying to protect them I guess.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You were just trying to protect them I guess.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: We sailed together so long. We were a family, but we three have all lived so long... Arguments and broken promises go back over the horizon of my memory.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We sailed together so long. We were a family, but we three have all lived so long... Arguments and broken promises go back over the horizon of my memory.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You should talk to each other.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should talk to each other.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You should talk to each other.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You should talk to each other.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You should all move on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should all move on.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: It was the Captain who kept us together. Unravelling the mysteries of The Gridless Sea was exciting, but we lost sense of ourselves out there. When she went overboard... it was a good time to go our separate ways and find ourselves again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was the Captain who kept us together. Unravelling the mysteries of The Gridless Sea was exciting, but we lost sense of ourselves out there. When she went overboard... it was a good time to go our separate ways and find ourselves again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Dredging up the past was never gonna do us any good. But at least we can bury the lies as well as the Captain now. Tell Salt Pete...I didn't mean to hurt him. And if you see Caleb, give him a message, ok? Tell him.... Stormy's Gone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dredging up the past was never gonna do us any good. But at least we can bury the lies as well as the Captain now. Tell Salt Pete...I didn't mean to hurt him. And if you see Caleb, give him a message, ok? Tell him.... Stormy's Gone.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: So the Captain is lost? And Crabface lied about finding her and burying her at sea. That's not very "pirate" of him. I guess we should tell Salt Pete...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So the Captain is lost? And Crabface lied about finding her and burying her at sea. That's not very "pirate" of him. I guess we should tell Salt Pete...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have them right here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have them right here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How can you tell after all this time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How can you tell after all this time?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How can you tell after all this time?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How can you tell after all this time?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I suppose you're speaking metaphorically.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I suppose you're speaking metaphorically.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So... you killed the Captain?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So... you killed the Captain?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But they didn't even try!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But they didn't even try!

nodes.text: Crabface completes the expedition
Crabface completes the expedition
